elements.label: Whole Timeline view screen recording (camera push-in, sidebar and 'Copied' toast cropped out)

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Marked ~460 ms after the push-in settles; the stem shows a broadband onset rather than a clear reversed-swoosh build, and it overlaps the narration ('managers'), so it may be residue or music rather than a designed SFX.

pattern.description: A post-production push-in on the screen recording (about 1.14x) toward the upper-left Timeline content, cropping the sidebar and the leftover 'Copied' toast so the timeline cards fill the frame.
pattern.why_premium: The zoom removes the navigation chrome and the stale toast right after the view switch, steering attention to the timeline as the narration says 'timeline view'; the decelerating move feels like a deliberate camera rather than a raw capture.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.screen', {scale:1, x:0, y:0}, {scale:1.136, xPercent:-6, yPercent:5.5, transformOrigin:'40% 30%', duration:0.35, ease:'power3.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:170, mass:1}}); apply transform `scale(${interpolate(p,[0,1],[1,1.136])})` with a matching translate; no overshoot.

notes: Camera verdict is push_in (scale 1.136). Energy decays steadily over the burst, suggesting an ease-out; code will measure. Sign of the pan is raw frame shift, described loosely here.
